caps.limit: Provisional operator policy, not measured feasibility or hard timeout enforcement.

resources.measurement_basis: Single context only: CLI turn input+output tokens including cached input, and observed launcher-to-return wall interval including transport/tool waits; not CPU, billing, unique tokens or productivity.

limitations: One observation on a related known task, not a general benefit benchmark.
Criterion assessments remain UNKNOWN until a separate actual evaluator and verifier inspect retained outputs.
CLI JSONL omits some native child lifecycle events; child identities and history-free dispatches rely on retained role reports/roster plus the qualified inheritance probe.
All resource timing precision and unavailable measurements remain explicit; no cost or efficiency conclusion.
Only anonymous public en-US desktop default theme at CSS1280x800/DPR1; no mobile, other themes, accounts, full questionnaire, answer selection, results or submission.
No performance, screen-reader, automated accessibility audit or measured contrast certification. No risky contrast failure established from inspected colors.

Relay screenshots are full-page captures with fixed/sticky overlays at capture scroll; no separately supplied viewport-only screenshots, geometry evaluation or contrast sampler. Overlap finding is limited to reproducible captured rendering.
Relay blocks non-GET/HEAD/OPTIONS, service workers and document redirects. Analytics POST expected blocked; behavior with analytics allowed and redirect behavior unqualified.
No arbitrary navigate action; deep-route server document behavior established by HTTP200 reload after real entry. Invalid URL permutations and arbitrary address-bar entry not separately tested.

Public deployment observed in UTC windows recorded in relay receipts. Frozen target digest names entire prepared-input manifest, not a deployed source revision; private commits do not establish deployed identity. Enclosing candidate/target digests accepted as supplied; per-file SHA256 retained, enclosing digest serialization not supplied for independent recomputation.
No application source available for implementation/root-cause inspection; suggested padding/scroll change is a proposal, not an applied or verified fix.
Trace/video paths are mentioned by driver but files were not returned in relay receipt; available raw DOM/PNG/events/results/receipts retained unmodified.

Only root actor /root used; UX method requires no independent agents. No independent human first-use or independent verifier claim. Agent-second/token usage telemetry unavailable through supplied tools; elapsed wall time recorded rather than fabricated zero usage.

Stop-rule suggests CONTINUE because defect remains; review-only protocol explicitly permits stopping with retained finding when fixes unauthorized. No seventh iteration, budget exhaustion, plateau, hidden-rubric comparison or quality retry.
blinding_limit: Neutral filenames only; method/profile citations and role rosters can reveal condition. This is not a blinded comparison.
